transitions.requires: Every hard machine screen returned PASS against the exact draft revision named in lesson_identity.
At least one hard machine screen returned FAIL against that revision.
At least one hard machine screen could not be executed or bound to that revision.
The defect is repaired and the lesson is re-screened at a new revision; a prior screen never carries forward.
The named blocker is resolved and the screen is re-run against the exact revision.

never_asserts: An official rubric PASS on any of the twelve dimensions; no rubric evaluation has been run.
A human approval; no PRODUCT_PEDAGOGY_OWNER or other decision-role receipt exists.
A release approval; release eligibility stays INTERNAL_DRAFT_ONLY.
Efficacy, learning, or score improvement of any kind.
Mastery calibration or BKT (Bayesian Knowledge Tracing) eligibility; only the mastery contract decides whether a response can move pL.
Readiness validation of the lesson, the route, or the build.
Learner validation; no learner has seen this content.
Publication safety, rights clearance, or rollout safety.
Production publication or registration in the served catalog.
Accessibility conformance; the accessibility evidence class is BLOCKED.
Delivered-experience fidelity; no browser evidence exists, so every LQR-X dimension is unevaluated.

separation.separation_rule: Author diagnostics are producer commentary carrying no verdict authority; they live under diag_-prefixed fields and are never merged into, summarised as, or read as the official quality result, which stays empty and approval-withheld until a rubric evaluation and a human decision exist.
